examples.english: Boss Qian's mind is full of work; every day he only thinks about how to make the company grow a bit faster.

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 為了家人的健康，媽媽每天都早起準備營養豐富的早餐，讓我們一天的開始就很有精神。
examples.pinyin: Wèile jiārén de jiànkāng, māma měitiān dōu zǎoqǐ zhǔnbèi yíngyǎng fēngfù de zǎocān, ràng wǒmen yì tiān de kāishǐ jiù hěn yǒu jīngshén.
examples.english: For the family's health, Mom gets up early every day to prepare a nutritious breakfast, so that we start the day full of energy.

examples.chinese: 我住的房子不大，也沒有很多錢，可是家人都很愛我， 讓我覺得很幸福、很滿足。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de fángzi bù dà, yě méiyǒu hěn duō qián, kěshì jiārén dōu hěn ài wǒ, ràng wǒ juéde hěn xìngfú, hěn mǎnzú.
examples.english: The house I live in isn't big, and I don't have a lot of money, but my family all love me, which makes me feel very happy and satisfied.

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 那個店員經常對客人微笑，讓人覺得很親切。
examples.pinyin: Nàge diànyuán jīngcháng duì kèrén wēixiào, ràng rén juéde hěn qīnqiè.
examples.english: That clerk often smiles at customers, making people feel very friendly.

examples.chinese: 父母應該好好地教育孩子，讓他們明白做人、做事的道理。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo de jiàoyù háizi, ràng tāmen míngbai zuòrén, zuòshì de dàolǐ.
examples.english: Parents should educate their children well, so that they understand the principles of conducting oneself and doing things.

examples.chinese: 我很餓，同事把他的薯條分一半給我，讓我好感動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn è, tóngshì bǎ tā de shǔtiáo fēn yí bàn gěi wǒ, ràng wǒ hǎo gǎndòng.
examples.english: I was very hungry, and my colleague shared half of his fries with me, which really moved me.

examples.chinese: 拜拜要用的發糕讓老鼠給吃了，讓媽媽非常生氣。
examples.pinyin: Bàibài yào yòng de fāgāo ràng lǎoshǔ gěi chī le, ràng māma fēicháng shēngqì.
examples.english: The fa gao (prosperity cake) to be used for the worship was eaten by mice, which made Mom very angry.

examples.chinese: 愛心服務社社員去安養院陪老人過年，讓老人們感覺相當溫暖。
examples.pinyin: Àixīn fúwùshè shèyuán qù ānyǎngyuàn péi lǎorén guò nián, ràng lǎorénmen gǎnjué xiāngdāng wēnnuǎn.
examples.english: The members of the Love Service Club went to the nursing home to accompany the elderly through the New Year, making the elderly feel quite warm.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生對客人很親切，讓客人都吃得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng duì kèrén hěn qīnqiè, ràng kèrén dōu chī de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: The waiters at that restaurant are very kind to the customers, which makes the customers all eat happily.

examples.chinese: 新電腦有問題，給他很多麻煩，讓他覺得白花錢了。
examples.pinyin: Xīn diànnǎo yǒu wèntí, gěi tā hěn duō máfan, ràng tā juéde bái huā qián le.
examples.english: The new computer has problems and gave him a lot of trouble, making him feel he spent money for nothing.

examples.chinese: 新電腦有問題，給他很多麻煩，讓他覺得白花錢了。
examples.pinyin: Xīn diànnǎo yǒu wèntí, gěi tā hěn duō máfan, ràng tā juéde bái huā qián le.
examples.english: The new computer has problems and gave him a lot of trouble, making him feel he spent money for nothing.

examples.chinese: 參加社團活動，是讓自己成長的好機會。孩子出國留學以後，父母發現孩子成長了不少。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā shètuán huódòng, shì ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng de hǎo jīhuì. Háizi chūguó liúxué yǐhòu, fùmǔ fāxiàn háizi chéngzhǎng le bùshǎo.
examples.english: Participating in club activities is a good opportunity for personal growth. After their child went abroad to study, the parents found that the child had grown a lot.

examples.chinese: 我剛買的皮包被小偷偷了，讓我又生氣又難過。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng mǎi de píbāo bèi xiǎotōu tōu le, ràng wǒ yòu shēngqì yòu nánguò.
examples.english: The purse I just bought was stolen by a thief, which made me both angry and sad.

examples.chinese: 媽媽說可樂太甜了，不讓我喝第二瓶。
examples.pinyin: Māma shuō kělè tài tián le, bù ràng wǒ hē dì-èr píng.
examples.english: Mom said cola is too sweet and won't let me drink a second bottle.

examples.chinese: 我剛去工作的時候，常常需要同事的幫助。幫助別人讓我覺得很快樂！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng qù gōngzuò de shíhou, chángcháng xūyào tóngshì de bāngzhù. Bāngzhù biérén ràng wǒ juéde hěn kuàilè!
examples.english: When I first started working, I often needed my colleagues' help. Helping others makes me feel very happy!

examples.chinese: 黃小姐生日那天，男朋友送給她九百九十九朵玫瑰花，讓她感動得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiǎojiě shēngrì nà tiān, nánpéngyǒu sòng gěi tā jiǔbǎi jiǔshí jiǔ duǒ méiguīhuā, ràng tā gǎndòng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: On Miss Huang's birthday, her boyfriend gave her 999 roses, which moved her incredibly.

examples.chinese: 今天是妹妹的生日，讓我們一起去 KTV 慶祝吧。弟弟還沒十八歲，爸爸不讓他喝酒。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì mèimei de shēngrì, ràng wǒmen yīqǐ qù KTV qìngzhù ba. / Dìdi hái méi shíbā suì, bàba bù ràng tā hē jiǔ.
examples.english: Today is younger sister's birthday; let's go to KTV to celebrate together. / Younger brother is not yet eighteen, so dad doesn't allow him to drink alcohol.

examples.chinese: 聽到那首歌，讓李小姐哭得很傷心。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào nà shǒu gē, ràng Lǐ xiǎojiě kū de hěn shāngxīn.
examples.english: Hearing that song made Miss Li cry very sadly.

examples.chinese: 他常常遲到，讓老闆很生氣。弟弟的房間又髒又亂，已經三個月沒打掃了，所以媽媽生他的氣。
examples.pinyin: Tā chángcháng chídào, ràng lǎobǎn hěn shēngqì. / Dìdi de fángjiān yòu zāng yòu luàn, yǐjīng sān ge yuè méi dǎsǎo le, suǒyǐ māma shēng tā de qì.
examples.english: He is often late, which makes his boss very angry. / Younger brother's room is both dirty and messy; it has been three months since it was cleaned, so mom is angry at him.

examples.chinese: 結婚的時候，先生送了她一棟房子，讓她開心極了。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn de shíhou, xiānsheng sòng le tā yī dòng fángzi, ràng tā kāixīn jí le.
examples.english: When they got married, her husband gave her a house, which made her extremely happy.

examples.chinese: 這對夫婦打扮得相當講究，讓我對他們從事的行業很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duì fūfù dǎbàn de xiāngdāng jiǎngjiū, ràng wǒ duì tāmen cóngshì de hángyè hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: This couple dresses quite elegantly, which makes me very interested in the profession they are engaged in.

examples.chinese: 就算擁有高收入，也不見得能讓你過著幸福美好的生活。
examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn yōngyǒu gāo shōurù, yě bújiàndé néng ràng nǐ guòzhe xìngfú měihǎo de shēnghuó.
examples.english: Even if you have a high income, it does not necessarily mean you can live a happy and wonderful life.

examples.chinese: 辦公時他常在桌上擺一杯熱咖啡，說是咖啡香能讓精神更好。
examples.pinyin: Bàngōng shí tā cháng zài zhuō shàng bǎi yī bēi rè kāfēi, shuō shì kāfēi xiāng néng ràng jīngshén gèng hǎo.
examples.english: When handling official business, he often places a cup of hot coffee on the desk, saying that the coffee aroma can make him feel more alert.

examples.chinese: 他很聰明，成績又非常好，因此完成初級班的課程後，學校讓他跳過中級，到高級班學習，一連跳了兩級。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn cōngmíng, chéngjì yòu fēicháng hǎo, yīncǐ wánchéng chūjí bān de kèchéng hòu, xuéxiào ràng tā tiàoguò zhōngjí, dào gāojí bān xuéxí, yīlián tiào le liǎng jí.
examples.english: He is very smart and his grades are also excellent, so after completing the beginner-level class curriculum, the school let him skip the intermediate level and study in the advanced class—he skipped two levels in a row.

examples.chinese: 世界各地的神話雖然不見得都真實，卻能讓人們多少了解一些古代的風俗習慣。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè gèdì de shénhuà suīrán bú jiàndé dōu zhēnshí, què néng ràng rénmen duōshǎo liǎojiě yīxiē gǔdài de fēngsú xíguàn.
examples.english: Although myths from around the world are not necessarily all true, they can still let people understand some ancient customs and habits to some extent.

examples.chinese: 學校的畢業典禮辦得很精彩，讓我們度過了愉快的一天。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de bìyè diǎnlǐ bàn de hěn jīngcǎi, ràng wǒmen dùguò le yúkuài de yī tiān.
examples.english: The school's graduation ceremony was held wonderfully, allowing us to spend a happy day.

examples.chinese: 他失業了，但妻子三人卻仍在一旁支持著他，讓他安心了不少。
examples.pinyin: Tā shīyè le, dàn qīzi sān rén què réng zài yīpáng zhīchí zhe tā, ràng tā ānxīn le bùshǎo.
examples.english: He lost his job, but his wife and three children still supported him on the side, which made him feel much more at ease.

examples.chinese: 我習慣在家裡放一盆花，讓室內有鮮花的香味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn zài jiālǐ fàng yī pén huā, ràng shìnèi yǒu xiānhuā de xiāngwèi.
examples.english: I am used to placing a pot of flowers at home, so that the room has the fragrance of fresh flowers.

examples.chinese: 這道菜味道獨特，香味及顏色也很迷人，讓人忍不住流口水。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài wèidào dútè, xiāngwèi jí yánsè yě hěn mírén, ràng rén rěnbuzhù liú kǒushuǐ.
examples.english: This dish has a unique flavor, and its aroma and color are also very charming, making people unable to resist drooling.

examples.chinese: 我們打算用擲銅錢的方式，來決定讓誰處理這件事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn yòng zhì tóngqián de fāngshì, lái juédìng ràng shéi chǔlǐ zhè jiàn shì.
examples.english: We plan to use the method of tossing a copper coin to decide who will handle this matter.

examples.chinese: 做生意與其花大錢廣告，不如提高品質，讓顧客替你宣傳。
examples.pinyin: Zuò shēngyì yǔqí huā dà qián guǎnggào, bùrú tígāo pǐnzhí, ràng gùkè tì nǐ xuānchuán.
examples.english: In doing business, rather than spending a lot of money to advertise, it is better to improve quality and let customers promote you.

examples.chinese: 巴德在華語能力測驗中得了86分，還拿到了華語高級證書，讓她開心了半天。
examples.pinyin: Bādé zài Huáyǔ nénglì cèyàn zhōng dé le bāshíliù fēn, hái ná dào le Huáyǔ gāojí zhèngshū, ràng tā kāixīn le bàntiān.
examples.english: Bade scored 86 on the Chinese proficiency test and also obtained an advanced Chinese certificate, which made her happy for a long time.

examples.chinese: 她推動學習革命，讓學生主動參與規劃課程。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuīdòng xuéxí gémìng, ràng xuéshēng zhǔdòng cānyǔ guīhuà kèchéng.
examples.english: She promoted a learning revolution, letting students actively participate in planning the curriculum.

examples.chinese: 裁判的工作是確定每位選手都遵守規定，讓比賽順利進行。
examples.pinyin: Cáipàn de gōngzuò shì quèdìng měi wèi xuǎnshǒu dōu zūnshǒu guīdìng, ràng bǐsài shùnlì jìnxíng.
examples.english: The referee's job is to make sure every athlete follows the rules, so that the competition runs smoothly.

examples.chinese: 這件事我根本不了解，所以沒辦法給你適當的建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ gēnběn bù liǎojiě, suǒyǐ méi bànfǎ gěi nǐ shìdàng de jiànyì.
examples.english: I simply don't understand this matter at all, so I have no way to give you appropriate advice.

examples.chinese: 教育是國家的根本，能改變國家的未來。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoyù shì guójiā de gēnběn, néng gǎibiàn guójiā de wèilái.
examples.english: Education is the foundation of a country; it can change the country's future.

examples.chinese: 蛋黃月餅的營養豐富，可是不能多吃，不然很容易發胖。
examples.pinyin: Dànhuáng yuèbǐng de yíngyǎng fēngfù, kěshì bùnéng duō chī, bùrán hěn róngyì fāpàng.
examples.english: Egg yolk mooncakes are rich in nutrition, but you can't eat too many, otherwise you'll easily gain weight.

items.wordHook: When someone is busy (忙), you help (幫) them → 幫忙 means to help.
A 方(direction) sign points where a 人(person) stands at the ice: the ⺀(ice) marks the spot → 於(at).
A rushing current of mountain 氵(water) flows past the grand 京(capital), making the autumn air briskly 涼(cold).
要是 means 'if': you want (要) a situation to be (是) true, so you say 'if'.
A pocket drive you 隨(follow) carry on your 身(body) shaped like a small 碟(plate): 隨身碟 means USB flash drive.
黑(black) + 板(board) → blackboard, the board you write on in class.
